verdict.rationale: Shopify's shipping page documents label purchasing at scale ('Create up to 250 labels at once') and order handling from all channels in one place, so the label-buying part of the story is supported first-party. Nothing in the pack shows live carrier rates at checkout or shipment tracking for merchants; the Order MCP's 'fulfillment events' covers only orders placed through an agent. Missing for 10: live carrier-calculated rates at checkout, shipment tracking from the admin, in-depth shipping docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
